summary: Morpheus introduces Neo to the remaining crew members (Mouse, Cypher, Switch, Tank, and Dozer) on the main deck of the Nebuchadnezzar. He points out the Core, a complex array of electronic equipment used to broadcast the pirate signal and hack the Matrix, which includes six ecto-skeleton chairs. Morpheus explains that the answer to what the Matrix is can be found in the Core. He guides a coaxial line with a cerebrum chip into the jack at the back of Neo's neck. After some disturbing noises and a loud click, Neo's eyes open, and the scene transitions to a feeling of weightlessness inside another place.

what_changes.before: Standing on the main deck, observing the crew and equipment
what_changes.after: Seated in an ecto-skeleton chair, physically connected to the Core via a coaxial line and cerebrum chip
what_changes.evidence: He feels Morpheus guiding a coaxial line into the jack at the back of his neck.

what_changes.before: Unfamiliar with the specific crew members Mouse, Cypher, Switch, Tank, and Dozer
what_changes.after: Has been introduced to them by name, though the names initially wash meaninglessly over him
what_changes.evidence: The ones you don't know. That's Mouse, Cypher, and Switch. Those two guys are Tank and Dozer.

event_hint.one_line: Neo is physically connected to the ship's hacking system to experience the Matrix's reality.
